verdict.rationale: Pinecone documents metadata filter expressions on queries with operators such as eq, in, gt and and. That covers range comparisons, set/array membership and boolean conjunction, but there is no evidence of geo filtering or of deeply nested or/and logic. missing for 10: geo filtering, documented nested boolean logic (or/not combinations), explicit array-field membership semantics, independent hands-on corroboration of filter expressiveness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can express rich filter conditions (ranges, geo, nested boolean logic, array membership) in queries

citations.quote: Narrow Pinecone search results by adding metadata filter expressions to your query, using operators like eq, in, gt, and gt, and for precise retrieval.
you can then include a metadata filter to limit the search to records matching the filter expression
